_doc: RACIALS - what a character has because of what they ARE, before any class or spec.
Kyle, 6 Nov, asked for these at WoW-authentic power: 'reroll-worthy', real throughput
and real utility, not flavour. Shape matches the personal kits in
data/npcs/personal_kits.json: 1-2 scalar passives + 2-3 abilities, INNATE - no ranks,
no talent gate, no level requirement. They live in the spellbook's CORE tab, which is
universals only: the basic attack, Shoot, Wand, and these.
SCOPE: the five races world/race_registry.py marks available=True. Goblin, Night Elf,
Troll, Dwarf and Gnome carry art but are available=False, so they are deliberately
absent rather than authored and unreachable. Turning one on later means adding its
entry here.
RECRUITS GET NOTHING FROM THIS FILE. All 68 are hard-coded human in
world/recruit_manager.py - Kyle's standing rule that they are real people from Earth,
not natives. Their uniqueness is their personal kit, which is the better answer anyway:
68 companions sharing one Human racial would have been 68 identical Core tabs.
EVERY RACIAL IS THE REAL WOW ONE, translated to turn-based. The 'wow' field names the
original. Where a mechanic does not survive the translation it is said so rather than
faked - WoW's Cannibalize needs a corpse to stand on and there are no corpses on a turn
meter, so Forsaken's version keys off a kill instead.
RESISTANCE VALUES ARE SMALL ON PURPOSE. The resistance rework (85fe92a) moved the cap
from 30% to 75% without rescaling anything that grants resistance, and
tools/audit_resistance_sources.py shows four of six schools already pinned at the 75%
cap by persistent party buffs alone. A racial handing out WoW's flat 10 is 12.5%
mitigation on a bar that is often already full. Kept at 10 to match WoW, flagged here
because it is the pending rescale that decides whether it matters.
BOSS IMMUNITY: 'boss_immune': true means the CONTROL portion is ignored by anything
flagged is_boss - Kyle, 6 Nov: 'for the really strong skills make it so they dont work
on bosses.' War Stomp's stun and Arcane Torrent's silence are exactly the effects that
would otherwise trivialise a boss. The damage, heal or resource half still applies.

DEAD-KEY CHECK, run before committing: every stat key here was checked against the engine. arcane_damage_pct is live (combat/abilities.py reads <school>_damage_pct through an f-string, which a naive grep misses). expertise, pet_damage, stun_duration_reduction_pct, crit_damage_physical and cc_immune are all live. spell_power_pct was DEAD and is now live - entities/character.py had a final multiplier for attack_power_pct and healing_power_pct but none for spell power, so Orc's Blood Fury would have done half its job. reputation_gain_pct is still dead and is marked as such on the Human entry rather than left to be discovered.

human.label: Human
human.note: Azerothian human. Earth-born transplants are a different thing entirely and carry a personal kit instead - see data/npcs/personal_kits.json.

passives._wow: The Human Spirit (+spirit) and Diplomacy (+reputation gain)
passives._needs_engine: reputation_gain_pct is not read by anything yet - the faction manager has no hook for a multiplier on rep gain. Authored because it is Diplomacy and Diplomacy is half of what Human IS; it does nothing until that hook exists, and this line is here so nobody has to discover that the hard way.

abilities.name: Every Man for Himself
abilities.wow: Every Man for Himself - removes all movement-impairing and loss-of-control effects
abilities.engine: needs: clear all control effects on self
abilities.description: Removes every stun, fear and snare on you.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.description: Reveals stealthed enemies for 3 turns and grants the party 3 hit rating.

passives._wow: Hardiness (stun duration reduction) and Command (pet damage)

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.wow: Blood Fury - a large attack power and spell power burst on a long cooldown
abilities.description: Increases your attack power and spell power by 15% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Axe Specialization
abilities.description: While wielding an axe, your attacks are 5 expertise harder to dodge or parry.

passives._wow: Magic Resistance - reduced damage from all magical schools

abilities.name: Arcane Torrent
abilities.wow: Arcane Torrent - silences nearby enemies and restores the caster's resource
abilities.engine: needs: silence; resource restore keyed to the caster's own resource type
abilities.description: Silences all enemies for 2 turns and restores 6% of your maximum resource. The silence does not work on bosses.

abilities.name: Arcane Affinity
abilities.wow: Arcane Affinity - an affinity for arcane magic
abilities.engine: needs: school-scoped damage bonus as a passive ability
abilities.description: Your arcane damage is increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.wow: Will of the Forsaken - immunity to fear, charm and sleep
abilities.engine: needs: timed immunity to a category of control
abilities.description: Removes any fear, charm or sleep on you and makes you immune to them for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.wow: Cannibalize - feed on a nearby corpse to regain health over time. There are no corpses to stand on in a turn-based fight, so it keys off a kill instead.
abilities.engine: needs: ability usable only after an enemy died this fight
abilities.description: Usable after an enemy dies. Restores 20% of your maximum health.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.description: Stuns all enemies for 1 turn. Does not work on bosses.

abilities.name: Brawn
abilities.wow: Tauren critical strikes deal more damage than other races'
abilities.description: Your critical strikes deal 4% more damage.
